# jenkins_folder (Resource)

Manages a folder within Jenkins, optionally nested inside another folder, with project-based security.

~> The Jenkins installation using this resource is expected to have the [Cloudbees Folders Plugin](https://plugins.jenkins.io/cloudbees-folder) installed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jenkins_folder" "team" {
  name        = "platform-team"
  description = "Folder for the platform team pipelines"
}

resource "jenkins_folder" "squad" {
  name        = "backend-squad"
  folder      = jenkins_folder.team.id
  description = "Nested subfolder for the backend squad"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The unique name of the JenkinsCI folder.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of this folder's purpose.
- `display_name` (String) The name of the folder to display in the UI.
- `folder` (String) The folder namespace to create this folder in. Nested folders are separated with `/`, e.g. `parent/child`. Cannot be changed after creation, and every parent folder must already exist.
- `security` (Block Set) The Jenkins project-based security configuration. At most one block may be specified. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--security))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The full canonical folder path, e.g. `/job/folder-name`.
- `template` (String) The Jenkins-compatible XML template describing the folder, as used to communicate with Jenkins. An existing folder's XML can be retrieved by appending `/config.xml` to its URL.

<a id="nestedblock--security"></a>
### Nested Schema for `security`

Required:

- `permissions` (Set of String) The Jenkins permission assignments granting access to this folder, each `<permission>:<user-or-group>`. Duplicates are collapsed and ordering is neither significant nor preserved, so elements cannot be referenced by index.

Optional:

- `inheritance_strategy` (String) The strategy for applying these permission sets to permissions inherited from parent folders and the global configuration. Defaults to `org.jenkinsci.plugins.matrixauth.inheritance.InheritParentStrategy`.

## Project-based security

~> The `security` block may need the [Matrix Authorization Strategy Plugin](https://plugins.jenkins.io/matrix-auth/) installed and enabled in the system's Global Security settings in order to function properly.

~> `permissions` was a list before **v1.2.2** and is a set from v1.2.2 onward. Existing `permissions = [...]` configuration keeps working unchanged, but expressions that index into the attribute do not — see [Upgrading to v1.2.2](../guides/upgrading-to-1.2.2).

Each entry pairs a Jenkins permission with the user or group it is granted to:

```hcl
security {
  permissions = [
    "hudson.model.Item.Build:username",
    "hudson.model.Item.Cancel:username",
    "hudson.model.Item.Configure:username",
    "hudson.model.Item.Create:username",
    "hudson.model.Item.Delete:username",
  ]
}
```

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Folders are imported by their canonical path.
terraform import jenkins_folder.team /job/platform-team

# A nested folder includes every parent in the path.
terraform import jenkins_folder.squad /job/platform-team/job/backend-squad
```
